title: Colour History and Distractor Effects in Interleaved and Blocked Visual Search: Secondary Analysis of Experiment 3
description: Reproducible secondary analysis of aggregate Experiment 3 data from Adam, Patel, Rangan & Serences (2021). Includes mixed-model code (Python and R) and results. Does not redistribute the original data. Code and draft text were developed with the assistance of an AI model; the author reviewed the analysis.
